title: Edible Moss
description: This is a texture pack that changes vanilla food items into moss.
body:
# INTRODUCTION
This is the official Modrinth page for the Edible Moss resource pack.

## HOW TO USE
To use the resource pack, open up Minecraft 1.20 or 1.20.1 (Either Works) and go into Settings > Options > Resource Packs. 

Once in the Resource Packs tab click on "Open Pack Folder" in the bottom left, once in the pack folder, paste in the version of Edible Moss that is compatible with your game. 

After it has been pasted in, it is a simple as hovering over the Edible Moss pack in Minecraft and clicking the arrow to put it into use.

## ISSUES
If you encounter any issues with the Edible Moss resource pack please open a forum in the Official Discord Server which can be found [here](https://discord.gg/PsqMX4HEjB).
